# ClimMob-analysis

> R workflow that analyses tricot trials (decentralised on-farm testing with farmer rankings) and writes the reports of the ClimMob platform. It also analyses one or several ClimMob projects on a local computer and exports tables ready for AI assistants.

Read AGENTS.md before working with this repository.

## Core files

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/ClimMob-analysis/master/AGENTS.md): instructions for AI agents
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/ClimMob-analysis/master/README.md): layout of the code, debugging, running locally
- [docs/outputs.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/ClimMob-analysis/master/docs/outputs.md): every output file and column
- [docs/combine-projects.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/ClimMob-analysis/master/docs/combine-projects.md): combining projects built from different templates
- [report/ai/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/ClimMob-analysis/master/report/ai/README.md): rules for writing feedback for participants

## Optional

- [run-local/analyse-one-project.R](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/ClimMob-analysis/master/run-local/analyse-one-project.R)
